results.sql_query:
WITH drug1_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '313782' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
drug1_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM drug1_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
drug1_hierarchy AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM drug1_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
),

drug2_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '1361615' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
drug2_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM drug2_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
drug2_hierarchy AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM drug2_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.person_id) FROM omop.person p
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM omop.drug_exposure de1
  WHERE de1.person_id = p.person_id
    AND de1.drug_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM drug1_hierarchy)
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM omop.drug_exposure de2
      WHERE de2.person_id = p.person_id
        AND de2.drug_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM drug2_hierarchy)
        AND CAST(
          EXTRACT(epoch FROM
            CAST(GREATEST(de1.drug_exposure_start_date, de2.drug_exposure_start_date) AS TIMESTAMP) -
            CAST(LEAST(de1.drug_exposure_start_date, de2.drug_exposure_start_date) AS TIMESTAMP)
          ) / 86400 AS BIGINT
        ) <= 30
    )
)
LIMIT 1000;
